name: phone-field
title: Phone field
description: A phone number with a searchable calling-code picker: digits group as typed, a pasted international number picks its country, and the value is stored as E.164.

when: Any phone number a person types: sign-up, checkout, contact details.

instead.when: The value is an extension or a short code, not a full number.

keyboard.does: Opens the country list from the country button.
Searches countries by name or calling code.

builtIn: The country button is named with the country and its code.
Too short and too long say so in words.
Required fields show "Fill in this field."
youProvide: suggestedCountries for the markets the form expects.

genui.description: A phone number with a country picker. Emits change with the E.164 value and the country.

label.description:
The visible label above the field. Leave it out only where something else names the number: a non-empty `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, or a form row's `<label htmlFor={id}>`. Inside
the DS `Field`, which gives its control the id, the Field's label is then the field's only label and its name
(`aria-labelledby` its `{id}-label`). A development warning says so when nothing names it.

defaultCountry.description: The country an empty field opens on; by default the locale's region ("de-AT" → AT, "en" → US).

PhoneField.name: label
PhoneField.description:
The visible label above the field. Leave it out only where something else names the number: a non-empty `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, or a form row's `<label htmlFor={id}>`. Inside
the DS `Field`, which gives its control the id, the Field's label is then the field's only label and its name
(`aria-labelledby` its `{id}-label`). A development warning says so when nothing names it.

PhoneField.name: aria-label
PhoneField.description: Names the number where no visible label is shown (a table cell, a context that already says it).

PhoneField.name: aria-labelledby
PhoneField.description: Ids of the elements that name the number, where no visible label of its own is shown.

PhoneField.name: value
PhoneField.description: The number in E.164 ("+38267123456"), or "" when empty. Controlled with `onChange`.

PhoneField.name: onChange
PhoneField.description:
The new E.164 value and the ISO country, together: an empty number still carries the chosen country,
so a form can keep both (the old shared field's contract, unchanged).

PhoneField.name: country
PhoneField.description:
Controlled ISO country. Left out, it is read from the value, then `defaultCountry`. A shared calling
code reads back as the table's first country for it (+1 → US): pass `country` to keep Canada.

PhoneField.name: defaultCountry
PhoneField.description: The country an empty field opens on; by default the locale's region ("de-AT" → AT, "en" → US).

PhoneField.name: suggestedCountries
PhoneField.description: ISO codes shown first, above "All countries" (the markets this form expects).

PhoneField.name: errorMessage
PhoneField.description: What happened and what to do. Wins over the field's own required and length checks.

PhoneField.name: requiredValidation
PhoneField.description:
Who says an empty required PhoneField is missing: `field` (default) shows "Fill in this field."
on blur and on a DS Form submit, which it then blocks, inside a DS Form of either `validationBehavior`; `app`
only marks the field. Outside a DS Form an empty value shows nothing either way. The app's `isInvalid` (or
`errorMessage`) wins over this message, and `isInvalid={false}` turns the check off. A disabled, empty, required
field still blocks a DS Form's submit and cannot take focus. See {@link RequiredValidation}.

PhoneField.name: isOptional
PhoneField.description: Shows "(optional)" when most of the form is required.

PhoneField.name: name
PhoneField.description: Submits the E.164 value under this name in a native form.

PhoneField.name: onUnsupportedInternationalPaste
PhoneField.description: A pasted international number whose country is not offered; the value stays unchanged.

PhoneField.name: id
PhoneField.description:
The number input's id: an app's `<label htmlFor>` and a focus-on-error reach the input, the
element that takes typing. The shared `Field` hands its control one. Left out, React Aria's own id stays.

PhoneField.name: aria-describedby
PhoneField.description: Ids of text outside the field that describes the number (a form row's hint or error), added to its own.

PhoneField.name: aria-invalid
PhoneField.description:
Set by a form row that owns the error text (the shared `Field` hands its control `aria-invalid`): the number is
marked invalid for assistive tech and drawn invalid, as with `isInvalid`; the row's message is the one shown,
since the field draws an error row only for its own `errorMessage` or length check. This field never uses
native validity, so it never blocks a form's submit.

PhoneField.name: countryLabel
PhoneField.description:
The country button's name, from the country's name and its calling code ("Country: Germany, +49" by default, in
the provider locale). For an app that words it itself; pass it already localized.

PhoneField.name: countryListLabel
PhoneField.description: The country list's name ("Country" by default), also its popover's. Already localized.

PhoneField.name: countrySearchLabel
PhoneField.description: The country search box's name ("Search countries" by default). Already localized.

PhoneField.name: countryEmptyMessage
PhoneField.description: The country list's empty result for the typed search ("No results for “{query}”." by default).

PhoneField.name: suggestedCountriesLabel
PhoneField.description:
The name of the country list's first section, the `suggestedCountries` ("Suggested countries" by default), which assistive tech
reads as the section's name. Already localized.

PhoneField.name: allCountriesLabel
PhoneField.description:
The header above the rest of the list, shown when `suggestedCountries` are shown above it ("All countries" by
default). Already localized.
